notes: Samoëns side (south), the side the Tour always climbs (1978-2023). Route: D354 Route de la Piaz from the Avenue des Glaciers (D907) junction by the Place des Sept Monts in Samoëns, Route de Plampraz from the Sous le Crêt junction (Route des Pleignes), Route de Vigny, Route de Cessonnex, and from the Mévoutier junction the Route du Col de Joux Plane to the col. The routed km of the junctions match cols-cyclisme (Sous le Crêt 1.2, La Combe aux Flés 3.2, Mévoutier 5.38 km) and the app landmarks; the routed GLO-30 profile matches the app's km gradients (701 m at the foot, ~1120 m at Mévoutier, 1687 m at the top). Finish: the road high point on the D354 (GLO-30 1687 m, IGN 1690/1691 m) at 11.61 km, just before the road dips past the Lac de Joux Plane and the restaurant; Wikipedia's col coordinate (46.1328, 6.7114) lies ~350 m north of the road on tracks and is not used. cols-cyclisme gives 11.5 km in its summary and 11.64 km for the variant from the town centre. Routed on Overture 11.61 km; km values scaled by 11.6/11.61. Hairpin numbers are not signposted, so hairpins are named by position.
sources: Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0 transportation segments (Route de la Piaz, Route de Plampraz, Route de Vigny, Route de Cessonnex, Route du Col de Joux Plane) and base/water (Lac de Joux Plane)
